subject: social_studies
concept: Identifying a real issue in the student's own community worth sustained civic attention
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 social studies sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student sorts candidate community issues by scope and how directly they could realistically engage with each
exercise.abstract: Student identifies a specific, real community issue and explains why it matters

misconception_flags: chooses an issue too abstract or distant for any realistic personal engagement

interest_binding: issue generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
